comment: Super Mario Eclipse's achievements: their names and what to do, as the in-game banner and SMS Launcher's Achievements page show them in Eclipse. Ids are the numbers the game unlocks (an Eclipse build's own, kept apart from Sunshine's); icons are assets/achievements/eclipse/<id>.png.
